Gifted with foresight, Nature's Prophet seems to be everywhere at a moment's notice. Trapping foes with a ring of trees [[Nature's Prophet#Sprout|Sprouted]] from the forest floor and [[Nature's Prophet#Teleportation|Teleporting]] at will to any location. The trees around him serve as his objects of power; using them, he instantly summons a [[Nature's Prophet#Nature's Call|Sentient Army]] of violent trees to fight for him, he attacks where enemies least expect. Channeling the goddess' fury, the Prophet strikes at every intruder in the land, bringing both the [[Nature's Prophet#Curse of the Oldgrowth|Curse of the Oldgrowth]] and the [[Nature's Prophet#Wrath of Nature|Wrath of Nature]] down on all who would do harm to Verodicia's creation. | complexity = 2 | roles = Carry, Pusher, Escape, Nuker | innate = Spirit of the Forest | ability1 = Sprout | ability2 = Teleportation | ability3 = Nature's Call | ability4 = Curse of the Oldgrowth;shard | ability5 = | ability6 = Wrath of Nature;aghs | adjectives = Arachnophobic, Bearded, Cape, Green, Nose | legs = 2 }} ==Bio== {{Hero bio | name = Nature's Prophet | alias = NP | quote = I woke within the seed and saw my destiny, and many were its branches. | soundclip = vo_furion_furi_rare_02.mp3 | voice = Eric Newsome | lore = When Verodicia, Goddess of the Woods, had finished filling in the green places, having planted the coiled-up spirit in the seed, having lured the twining waters from deep within the rock, having sworn the sun its full attention to the growing things, she realized that her own time had reached its end, and like one of the leaves whose fate she had imprinted in the seed, she would fall without seeing the fruiting of her dream. It pained her to leave the world bereft, for the sprouts had not yet broken through the soil--and they would be tender and vulnerable to every sort of harm. She found in her seed pouch one last seed that she had missed in the sowing. She spoke a single word into the seed and swallowed it as she fell. Her vast body decomposed throughout the long winter, becoming the humus that would feed the seedlings in the spring. And on the morning of the vernal equinox, before the rest of the forest had begun to wake, that last seed ripened and burst in an instant. From it stepped Nature's Prophet, in full leaf, strong and wise, possessing Verodicia's power to foresee where he would be needed most in defense of the green places--and any who might be fortunate enough to call him an ally. }} ==Upgrades== ===Aghanim's=== {{Aghcard | hero = Nature's Prophet | aghname0 = Wrath of Nature | aghdesc0 = {{Show|A|Nature's Prophet|Wrath of Nature|desc2}} | shdname0 = Curse of the Oldgrowth | shddesc0 = new }} ===Talents=== {{Talents | hero = Nature's Prophet | t4l = ×s:value {{A|Nature's Prophet|Nature's Call|text=Treant}} Health/Damage | v4l = 3 | t4r = No {{A|Nature's Prophet|Teleportation}} Cooldown | v4r = | t3l = +s:value {{A|Nature's Prophet|Sprout}} Damage | v3l = 240 | t3r = -s:values {{A|Nature's Prophet|Wrath of Nature}} Cooldown | v3r = 20 | t2l = +s:value {{A|Nature's Prophet|Teleportation}} {{M|Damage Barrier|t=all}} | v2l = 100 | t2r = +s:value {{A|Nature's Prophet|Nature's Call|text=Treant}} Move Speed | v2r = 50 | t1l = +s:value {{A|Nature's Prophet|Wrath of Nature}} Base Damage | v1l = 25 | t1r = -s:values {{A|Nature's Prophet|Nature's Call}} Cooldown | v1r = 10 | notes = }} =={{Symbol|Innate|size=32px}} [[Innate]]== ===Spirit of the Forest=== {{Spellcard | ID = 1298 | intern = furion_spirit_of_the_forest | name = Spirit of the Forest | icon0 = Nature's Prophet Spirit of the Forest | type0 = inn | target0 = Passive | affect0 = Self | desc0 = Grants the Prophet bonus base attack damage per tree within the proximity radius. | basic1 = 10;Tree Proximity Radius Increase | traitamp = aoe | trait1 = Tree Proximity Radius | value1 = 300 | trait2 = Attack Damage Bonus per Tree | value2 = 2% | icon1 = Nature's Prophet Nature's Call | type1 = inn | target1 = Passive | desc1 = The Prophet's Treants are considered as valid trees.

The name was removed later on for unknown reasons. ** As of now, Nature's Prophet's name is not known. * Nature's Prophet is sometimes called the "Nature's Profit" within the community, due to his farming and split-pushing playstyle. * Nature's Prophet's early lore concept made him the father of {{H|Anti-Mage}} and {{H|Terrorblade}}, but was changed later on. ** The old lore was based on the lore within DotA1, where he is the father of them as well. * Nature's Prophet's spawn response vo_furion_furi_spawn_01.mp3 "I speak for the trees." is a reference and homage to Dr. Seuss' [[wikipedia:The Lorax|The Lorax]]. * Nature's Prophet's last-hit response vo_furion_furi_lasthit_07.mp3 "Green is good." is a quote from the 1987 film [[wikipedia:Wall Street (1987)|Wall Street]]. ** It also references the Warcraft 3 cheatcode "greedisgood", which grants the player gold and lumber. * Nature's Prophet's {{Rune|Illusion}} response vo_furion_furi_illus_02.mp3 "Leaves of three, let them be." is a traditional rhyme for identifying and avoiding [[wikipedia:Poison Ivy|Poison Ivy]]. * {{wc3}} similarities: ** Nature's Prophet's hero concept is originally based on [https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Malfurion_Stormrage Furion], a campaign-only variant of the {{wc3|Night Elf}} {{wc3|Keeper of the Grove}} hero. *** Nature's Prophet was named Furion as well, but it was changed in Dota 2 to avoid copyright issues with "Blizzard Entertainment". *** Within the community and within some game files, he is still commonly refered to as Furion. *** {{A|Nature's Prophet|Nature's Call}}'s original iteration was identical to the Keeper of the Grove's {{wc3|Keeper of the Grove|Force of Nature}}. **** In DotA, the ability is named Force of Nature as well. The name was likely changed to differentiate it more from his ultimate. **** The {{U|Treant}} itself is based on, and has the same name as the Warcraft 3 {{wc3|Treant}}. *** Nature's Prophet's old ability {{A|Nature's Prophet|Entangling Roots}} was identical to the Keeper of the Grove's {{wc3|Keeper of the Grove|Entangling Roots}}. *** Nature's Prophet's old ultimate, {{A|Nature's Prophet|Tranquility Aura}} was inspired by the Keeper of the Grove's {{wc3|Keeper of the Grove|Tranquility}}. ** {{A|Nature's Prophet|Teleportation}}'s original iteration was identical to the {{wc3|Warden}}'s {{wc3|Warden|Blink}}, with a high cast time and global cast range. ** {{A|Nature's Prophet|Wrath of Nature}}'s original iteration was identical to the {{wc3|Far Seer}}'s {{wc3|Far Seer|Chain Lightning}}, with global cast and bounce range. ==Gallery== Nature's Prophet Model.jpg|Model Treant Model.jpg|Treant model Nature's Prophet cosmetic set1.jpg|Item [[concept art]] Nature's Prophet cosmetic set2.jpg|Item concept art Nature's Prophet cosmetic set3.jpg|Item concept art Nature's Prophet cosmetic table.jpg|Item concept table The One True King Bone Harvest Nature's Prophet.png|[[Bone Harvest]] sprite - alive The One True King Bone Harvest Nature's Prophet dead.png|Bone Harvest sprite - dead Dota 2 Monster Hunter codex nature's prophet gameasset.png|[[Dota 2 X Monster Hunter/Hero Atlas#Nature's_Prophet|Monster Hunter Hero Atlas Illustration]] [[ru:Nature's Prophet]]
